def clip_polygon(polygon,evaluate):
    if not polygon: return []
    result=[]; previous=polygon[-1]; previous_value=evaluate(previous)
    for current in polygon:
        current_value=evaluate(current)
        if (current_value>=0)!=(previous_value>=0):
            weight=previous_value/(previous_value-current_value)
            result.append(tuple(previous[axis]+weight*(current[axis]-previous[axis]) for axis in range(len(current))))
        if current_value>=0: result.append(current)
        previous=current; previous_value=current_value
    return result
